english: And suppose another person comes along who has no cataracts on their eyes. They have none of this tendency for seeing a false object; one which simply isn't there-the hair or whatever it may be. And this is because their state of mind is one which is not mistaken. We could never say, again, that there was present there even a tiny percentage of any object which did not exist in a deceptive manner.
